characters.name: Kabir
characters.description: A seasoned courier navigating the contested sector.

characters.name: Meera
characters.description: An archivist seeking the forgotten vault.

characters.name: Dr. Sen
characters.description: A field medic bound by vows of non-violence.

items.name: bronze key
items.description: An antique bronze key opening the archives vault.

rules.name: Physical Invariants
rules.description: Injured limbs cannot sustain heavy load without healing.

chapters.title: Scene 1: The Briefing
chapters.text: Kabir checked his gear at the safehouse. Meera held her grandmother's bronze key tightly in her hand.

chapters.title: Scene 2: Ambush at the Rail yard
chapters.text: Gunfire erupted across the freight yard. A stray bullet shattered Kabir's right shoulder.

chapters.title: Scene 3: The Exchange
chapters.text: Desperate for medical supplies, Meera pawned the bronze key to a fence.

chapters.title: Scene 4: The Infirmary
chapters.text: Dr. Sen treated the wounded refugees quietly. He was a devout physician who abhorred violence.

chapters.title: Scene 5: The Sniper's Perch
chapters.text: Kabir climbed the water tower. He raised the sniper rifle with his right shoulder and took steady aim.
